title: Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension

result.label: Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension
result.statement: For every minimal homeomorphism h of an infinite compact metrizable space X , the radius of comparison of C(X) Z equals 12 mdim (X,h), including infinite values. Zero mean dimension is equivalent to the small boundary property, Jiang–Su stability and finite nuclear dimension; in this case nuclear dimension is at most one.
